newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gammon to build Carlsberg China brewery.
newsitem.headline: Gammon to build Carlsberg China brewery.

text.p: Gammon Construction Ltd said on Tuesday its China unit has been awarded a 114 million yuan contract to design and build a brewery in Shanghai, China.

Under the contract awarded by Carlsberg Brewery (Shanghai) Co Ltd, Gammon Construction (China) will design and build a brewery capable of producing 500,000 hectolitres a year on a greenfield site at Songjiang Industrial Zone in Shanghai.
The turnkey contract comprises the brewhouse, silos, an energy centre, packaging areas and other facilities.
The works is being designed to cater for Carlsberg's process equipment, which is to be installed by November 1997.
Gammon is owned by Jardine Matheson group and Kvaerner.
